remarks: Imagine waking up in a sunlit bedroom, sipping coffee on your private balcony, and being just minutes from the best of Stamford - shopping, dining, the train, and vibrant downtown life. This updated, move-in-ready condo blends modern style with everyday practicality, creating a home you'll love from the moment you walk in. Step inside through your own entrance and find a flexible den - your new home office, workout spot, or creative studio. Head upstairs to the heart of the home: a gorgeous farmhouse-inspired kitchen with a subway tile backsplash, butcher-block countertops, trendy open shelving, and bold accent walls. The bright, open living and dining area offers plenty of space to gather with friends, relax with a book, or host game night. Open the door to your balcony, spacious enough for two cozy seating areas and a coffee table - perfect for lazy Sunday mornings or summer evening get-togethers. Upstairs, you'll find two comfortable bedrooms, including a primary suite with a walk-in closet and oversized windows that welcome the daylight. Extra storage? You've got it - with pull-down attic space and room in the garage. Plus, enjoy the ease of a first-floor washer/dryer, central air, heat, and parking for a second car. This is more than just a condo - it's a home that gives you style, space, and a location that makes life easy. All that's left to do is move in. Laminate floor on first floor "As Is".
